```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# pak::pak("haleyjeppson/ggmosaic")
library(ggmosaic)

```



## The Data

```{r}
ikea_places <- readr::read_csv(
    'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-27/ikea_places.csv'
)
ikea_seating <- readr::read_csv(
    'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-10-27/ikea_seating.csv'
)

ikea <- ikea_seating |>
    select(category, name) |>
    distinct() |>
    inner_join(ikea_places, by = "name")
```


```{r}
ikea |>
    count(place_type, category) |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_mosaic(aes(x = product(place_type), fill = category, weight = n)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        #axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 270, vjust = 0.5, hjust=0),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_flip()
```


```{r}
ikea |>
    select(place_type, category) |>
    table()
```



```{r}
ikea_seating |>
    ggplot(aes(x = price_usd, y = country, color = category)) +
    geom_point()
```


```{r}
jattebo <- ikea_seating |>
    filter(product_name == "JÄTTEBO")

jattebo |>
    ggplot(aes(x = price_usd, fill = country)) +
    geom_histogram()
```


```{r}
ikea_seating |>
    filter(
        country %in% c("mx", "ae", "us", "se", "th", "de", "au", "jp", "kr")
    ) |>
    group_by(country, product_name) |>
    summarize(count = n()) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = count)) +
    geom_histogram() +
    facet_grid(country ~ 1)
```


```{r}
countries <- ikea_seating |> distinct(country)
```
